entities.name: Evžen Plocek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Evžen Plocek was a Czech man who committed suicide, at age 39, by self-immolation as a political protest. He is usually named together with Jan Palach and Jan Zajíc whose self-immolations were similar political protests as Plocek's, but his death did not bring the same attention as the death of his predecessors.
